post.summary: Scan local filenames with the bound saved parser profile and atomically replace song metadata
post.description: Administrator/CSRF protected synchronous filename-only scan. LOCAL only; WebDAV returns 400 without remote requests. Includes nested directories without following symlinks. Limits: 2000 media files, 20000 visited entries, 32 directory levels, 30 seconds traversal/parse budget. Supported extensions: mkv, mp4, mpg, mpeg, avi, ts, vob, mov, wmv. Unmatched files remain as needs-review records. A completed scan replaces the source index and removes records for disappeared files; originals are never modified. Failure/limit/configuration change keeps prior index. Repeated filenames retain stable IDs. Profile changes apply on next scan. 60s browser request timeout; WebDAV uses the separate scan-tasks API. If a previously indexed source suddenly produces zero media files, returns 409 and preserves its index to guard against an empty disconnected mount.

post.summary: Queue a WebDAV filename-only scan
post.description: Administrator session required; writes require CSRF. WEBDAV sources only for creation. Uses Depth: 1 PROPFIND, never media GET/HEAD or redirects. Limits: 100000 media, 1000000 child entries, 128 directory levels, two hours; connect timeout 10s, each directory request 60s and 64 MiB. Two workers and 32 queued tasks; one active task per source. Full staged result is published atomically. Restart interrupts tasks; manually restart scanning. Task IDs are scoped to their source. Terminal tasks retained seven days with at least the latest per source. No credentials or response XML returned.

get.description: Empty path lists filesystem roots. Absolute paths are canonicalized. Child symbolic links are omitted. Directories are ordered by name, 100 per page. Does not change filesystem permissions or Docker mounts.

get.summary: Stream original audio or video
get.description: Administrator-only original audio/video streaming. The legacy /video path is retained for compatibility. MIME type follows the indexed filename extension. Local canonical paths stay inside the source. WebDAV credentials stay on the server; redirects are refused. No transcoding or media caching.

code.description: Six-digit TOTP or one unused 32-character recovery code.

secret.description: Base32 RFC 4648 secret, shown only during pending setup.

location.description: LOCAL: absolute server-visible readable directory, canonicalized on save. WEBDAV: HTTP(S) collection URL without userinfo, query or fragment; normalized with a trailing slash. Saving never connects to WebDAV.

username.description: WebDAV only; empty for anonymous access.

password.description: WebDAV only. Omitted/null retains the saved password only when URL and username are unchanged; empty string clears it. Stored encrypted; never returned.

parserProfileId.description: Saved parser profile ID. Creation defaults to default when omitted; update preserves the existing binding when omitted/null. Profile must exist. Local and WebDAV scans use its enabled rules in saved order.

scanEnabled.description: Enable automatic scanning; omitted on update preserves existing configuration.

scanCron.description: Standard five fields: minute hour day month weekday, Asia/Shanghai; day and weekday restrictions use Unix OR semantics. Required when enabled. Example: 0 3 * * *.

location.description: LOCAL: absolute server-visible readable directory, canonicalized on save. WEBDAV: HTTP(S) collection URL without userinfo, query or fragment; normalized with a trailing slash. Saving never connects to WebDAV.

username.description: WebDAV only; empty for anonymous access.

parserProfileId.description: Saved parser profile ID. Creation defaults to default when omitted; update preserves the existing binding when omitted/null. Profile must exist. Local and WebDAV scans use its enabled rules in saved order.

scanEnabled.description: Enable automatic scanning; omitted on update preserves existing configuration.

scanCron.description: Standard five fields: minute hour day month weekday, Asia/Shanghai; day and weekday restrictions use Unix OR semantics. Required when enabled. Example: 0 3 * * *.

FilenameRule.description: Ordered rule. BUILTIN requires builtinId and a null/omitted expression; custom rules require an expression and no builtinId. Templates and RE2 named groups require artist/title; optional code/language/version/quality/extra. All supplied rules, including disabled rules, are validated.

PreviewFilename.description: Omitted/null rules uses the saved configuration. An empty array explicitly disables all rules. Draft preview does not persist.

FilenameParseResult.description: Artist/title structure evidence, not verified musical identity. Auxiliary labels may remain on SUCCESS results. songCode preserves leading zeros.

FilenameParserWorkspace.description: Consistent shared snapshot. changedId identifies a created/updated/deleted entity; null on GET. Enablement/order belong to profile entries. GET projects legacy data without persistence.

fileSize.description: Null when the WebDAV directory response does not provide this property; no media file request is made.

modifiedAt.description: Null when the WebDAV directory response does not provide this property; no media file request is made.

metadata.description: Separate confirmed overlay. Ignore when stale; raw filename result remains unchanged.

MediaScanTask.description: Persisted background WebDAV filename scan. Counts report discovered work; no total or percentage is available while enumerating. Terminal errors are sanitized; old index remains on failure/cancellation/interruption.

minIntervalSeconds.description: Batch delay range in seconds after each song. Maximum must be >= minimum; omitted fields use defaults.

maxIntervalSeconds.description: Batch delay range in seconds after each song. Maximum must be >= minimum; omitted fields use defaults.

confidence.description: Presentation guidance only. HIGH meets batch similarity threshold; LOW is >=.8 but below threshold; NONE is missing or <.8. Raw score and automatic rules unchanged.

coverAvailable.description: Current nonstale confirmed cover available; browser still handles proxy/image failure.

total.description: Overall songs considered, including skippedExisting; equals pending + processing + review + applied + failed + skippedExisting.

completed.description: Judged/processed songs, including skippedExisting; equals review + applied + failed + skippedExisting. Review does not mean metadata applied.

skippedExisting.description: Songs skipped at creation because valid confirmed metadata already exists; included in total and completed.

processableTotal.description: Songs that require platform processing in this batch; total minus skippedExisting.

legacySkipped.description: Historic skipped songs whose IDs were never recorded. Included in global counts but absent from searchable item rows; no fabricated backfill.

observedAt.description: Server observation time for this consistent transaction; not a fabricated item update timestamp.

ReviewApply.description: Manual edits override candidate values for selected fields only. Cover cannot be supplied via edits: use owned candidate or managed asset. Empty values preserve current values. fingerprint/version enforce optimistic concurrency. Identical requestId + payload replays receipt for seven days; changed payload with reused ID returns 409. Manual entry/upload works without enabling external providers.

parent.description: Null for the filesystem root listing; empty string returns to that listing.
